dossier_meta.authors: Fomin, Fedor V., Heggernes, Pinar, Kratsch, Dieter
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Coloring » Homomorphisms
dossier_meta.statement_text: Question Is there an algorithm that decides, for input graphs $ G $ and $ H $ , whether there exists a homomorphism from $ G $ to $ H $ in time $ O(c^{|V(G)|+|V(H)|}) $ for some constant $ c $ ?
dossier_meta.context_text: An affirmative answer is known in several cases: if $ H=K_k $ (graph coloring) [L], [BH], [K]; if $ H $ has bounded treewidth [FHK]; if $ H $ has bounded cliquewidth [W].
